It was ported to JavaScript by Luke Woodward (Github). variables.rawdescription:
Generic Firestore converter for plain data objects (no methods).

App contract:
- **Read:** stored `null` becomes app `undefined` (`toAppModelRecursive`).
- **Full write** (`options` omitted): top-level `undefined` becomes stored `null`.
- **Merge / partial write** (`options` passed, e.g. `{ merge: true }`):
 - `undefined` omitted (leave field unchanged).
 - explicitly `null` becomes `deleteField()` (clear optional field).
- Dates become `Timestamp`s; nested plain objects recurse with the same rules.

functions.description:
Builds one IntermediateSeriesResult per distinct merge group. For each group we:

Per-hull SeriesEntries are always created at sign-on (one per boatClass+sailNumber+helm). The series-level entryAlgorithm controls only how those per-hull entries are merged when scoring the series:

src/app/shared/firebase/firestore-helper.rawdescription:
Generic Firestore converter for plain data objects (no methods).

App contract:
- **Read:** stored `null` becomes app `undefined` (`toAppModelRecursive`).
- **Full write** (`options` omitted): top-level `undefined` becomes stored `null`.
- **Merge / partial write** (`options` passed, e.g. `{ merge: true }`):
 - `undefined` omitted (leave field unchanged).
 - explicitly `null` becomes `deleteField()` (clear optional field).
- Dates become `Timestamp`s; nested plain objects recurse with the same rules.
